channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: A Peugeot Beat a Mercedes in This Seven-Seat EV Test
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying lines up the Peugeot E-5008 against the Mercedes GLB Electric. With more boot space and a 14,000-pound saving, the French seven-seater takes the win.

item.title: He Ran Solar Panels 400 Feet and Measured the Power Loss
item.dc:creator: Minute Man Solar
item.description: Minute Man Solar measures voltage and amps at the panels and again 400 feet away at the shed. With heavy-gauge wire, the readings barely move.

item.title: The Offshore Wind Boom Most People Never See
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric TECH
item.description: Professor Deborah Greaves explains the UK's offshore wind scale-up: 16-megawatt turbines, floating platforms, tidal power, and a plan to roughly six-fold capacity by 2040.

item.title: The 2026 IONIQ 5 Got Cheaper, and That Changes the Math
item.dc:creator: Micah Muzio
item.description: After a price cut of up to roughly $9,800, Micah Muzio argues the IONIQ 5 beats the Rivian R2 on real-world value, with 318 miles of range and a 20-minute fast charge.

item.title: Why a $40 Sodium Battery Could Reset Grid Storage
item.dc:creator: The Electric Viking
item.description: The Electric Viking lays out BYD's target of $40-per-kWh sodium grid cells by 2027 and argues cycle life, not the sticker price, is what makes the number matter.

item.title: Kindred Motorworks Puts 300 Horsepower Under a Classic VW Microbus
item.dc:creator: TFLEV
item.description: TFLEV drives Kindred's electric VW Type 2 restomod: a 23-window classic with about 300 horsepower, a 74 kWh pack, a 200-mile range, and a $249,000 starting price.

item.title: Plug-In Solar Panels Are Everywhere in Europe and Stuck in the UK
item.dc:creator: UpsideDownFork
item.description: UpsideDownFork shows plug-in balcony solar feeding a home through a three-pin plug, explains why it is mainstream across Europe, and why the UK still lags on the rules.

item.title: Six Months With a Model 3 RWD: The Self-Driving Mattered More Than the Electric
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: After six months and nearly 9,000 miles on a roughly $300 lease, Out of Spec says it was FSD, not the powertrain, that pulled a first-time EV driver in.

item.title: One Homesteader Wired a 36-Panel Off-Grid Solar System Mostly Alone
item.dc:creator: The Pastured Homestead
item.description: The Pastured Homestead documents a DIY off-grid build: 36 ground-mounted panels, EG4 inverters, and a battery bank, fighting snow and mud at every step.

item.title: Podcast Roundtable Bets the Cheap Slate Truck Sells on Fleets, Not Frills
item.dc:creator: Batteries Included Podcast
item.description: The podcast digs into Slate's confirmed $24,950 truck, argues base buyers are real, and covers fresh Lucid job cuts and a Rivian entry-trim change.

item.title: The Updated Polestar 3 Switches to 800 Volts and Faster Charging
item.dc:creator: Autogefühl
item.description: Polestar's mid-life update moves the 3 to an 800-volt system, cutting a 10 to 80 percent charge to about 22 minutes. Autogefühl runs a hot-weather range test and says skip the performance pack.

item.title: CATL's TENER Sodium Battery Promises a 25-Year Grid Stack
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric TECH
item.description: At Intersolar, Everything Electric looks at CATL's sodium-ion storage system. The company claims long life, extreme-temperature tolerance, and lower cost than lithium. The figures are CATL's own.

item.title: Ten Used EVs You Can Buy in the UK for Under £10,000
item.dc:creator: More High Peak
item.description: Steep depreciation has dropped a former World Car of the Year and an early Tesla Model S under £10,000. More High Peak ranks ten used EVs and says check battery health first.

item.title: Munro Live Rides in the $24,950 Slate and Explains the Price
item.dc:creator: Munro Live
item.description: Slate confirmed its electric truck starts at $24,950 with 205 miles of range. Munro Live walks the engineering with Sandy Munro: manual windows, composite panels, and a big frunk.

item.title: Polestar Says It Will Stop US Sales Over Connected-Vehicle Rules
item.dc:creator: The Electric Viking
item.description: The Electric Viking reports Polestar will end US sales after this model year under a federal connected-vehicle rule tied to Chinese ownership, while sister brand Volvo was cleared to continue.

item.title: Richard Hammond Drives the Zeekr 7X: 646 Horsepower for Around £45,000
item.dc:creator: DRIVETRIBE
item.description: Richard Hammond track-tests the Zeekr 7X in Australia, launching and towing a 646-horsepower electric SUV he pegs at around £45,000, well under a luxury saloon.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
